Bug: Silent error handling in views — try? swallows user-facing errors
description: P0 bug: 29 try? operations in UI code silently swallow errors. Critical locations: PlantReminderDetailView (6 silent reminder failures), OnboardingNavigationView (13 Keychain writes), JournalEntryDetailView (3 save failures), MyGardenAddPlantViews (seed failure). Replace try? with do/catch + error state for critical user-facing operations. Add tests verifying errors surface. File: ErrorSurfacingTests.swift + view modifications. ~10-15 tests.
notes: Deferred: requires production code changes (replacing try? with do/catch in views). ReminderService integration tests (growwise-efu) confirmed createSmartReminder uses try (not try?) so errors propagate at service level. View-layer try? fixes tracked separately.
close_reason: Fixed silent try? in 4 view files: PlantReminderDetailView (5 fixes), OnboardingNavigationView (13 try? converted to do/catch), JournalEntryDetailView (2 save fixes), MyGardenAddPlantViews (2 fixes). All now surface errors via .alert. Added ADR-007 (no silent try?) and ADR-008 (test-friendly services).

title: bug: My Garden view doesn't refresh after creating garden or adding plant
description: When a garden is created via CreateGardenSheet or a plant is added via AddPlantToGardenSheet, the MyGardenView does not reload its data after the sheet dismisses. This means newly created gardens won't show in the garden selector, and newly added plants won't appear in the plant grid until the user manually pulls to refresh. Root cause: loadData() only runs once via .task on view appear, with no mechanism to reload when sheets close. Partial fix added: .onChange(of: showingCreateGarden/showingAddPlant) handlers, but these may not be sufficient depending on timing.
